formMetadata.purpose: Form I-131 is filed by or on behalf of an applicant to request a reentry permit, refugee travel document, TPS travel authorization document, advance parole document, initial parole document, parole in place, re-parole, or arrival/departure record from U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services under various provisions of the Immigration and Nationality Act.
formMetadata.situations: Reentry Permit: LPRs or conditional permanent residents who intend to travel abroad for extended periods (up to 2 years) and wish to preserve their resident status (8 CFR §223.2). Refugee Travel Document: Persons holding refugee or asylee status, or LPRs who obtained status as a direct result of refugee/asylee status, who wish to travel abroad and return (8 CFR §223.2(b)). TPS Travel Authorization Document: TPS beneficiaries inside the U.S. seeking to travel abroad and return under INA §244(f)(3). Advance Parole: Individuals inside the U.S. with a pending I-485, approved U or T visa, DACA, pending asylum, V nonimmigrant status, Family Unity, or other qualifying basis, seeking advance permission to travel and re-enter under INA §212(d)(5)(A). Initial Parole Document: Individuals outside the U.S. applying under specific parole programs (FWVP, FRTF, intergovernmental referral, etc.) under INA §212(d)(5)(A). Parole in Place: Individuals inside the U.S. seeking parole in place under programs such as Military PIP, IMMVI, or other processes under INA §212(d)(5)(A). Re-parole: Individuals previously paroled or granted PIP seeking a new period of parole under various programs.
formMetadata.use-cases: 1) LPR planning a 14-month work assignment abroad files for a reentry permit. 2) Asylee wishes to visit a third country (not country of persecution) and needs a refugee travel document. 3) LPR who obtained green card through asylum needs a refugee travel document to travel. 4) TPS holder from Haiti needs to travel to Canada and return. 5) I-485 pending applicant needs to travel for family emergency and files for advance parole (or combo card via I-765/I-131). 6) U visa holder with approved I-918 needs advance parole to travel. 7) DACA recipient with approved I-821D seeks advance parole for educational purposes. 8) Individual outside the U.S. applies for initial parole under the Filipino WWII Veterans Parole Program. 9) Family member of military service member inside the U.S. applies for parole in place under Military PIP. 10) Ukrainian citizen previously paroled into the U.S. after Feb 11, 2022 seeks re-parole. 11) Afghan parolee after July 31, 2021 seeks re-parole and concurrent EAD.
formMetadata.filing-context: I-131 may be filed standalone or concurrently with other forms. It is commonly filed with I-485 (adjustment of status) and I-765 (EAD) as a package, in which case USCIS may issue a combo EAD/AP card. For reentry permits and refugee travel documents, the applicant must be physically present in the U.S. at the time of filing and generally must appear for biometrics before departure. For advance parole based on pending I-485, if filed concurrently, no separate filing fee is required. Supporting evidence varies by application type: passport copies, I-94 records, I-797 approval/receipt notices, refugee/asylee documentation, TPS approval, military service records, etc. Filed at USCIS lockbox (Dallas or Chicago depending on category) or online via myUSCIS. The form edition is 01/20/25 with OMB expiration 06/30/2027. For replacement documents, a prior I-131 receipt number is needed. Part 8 applies to initial parole, PIP, and re-parole applicants. G-28 required if attorney/representative is filing.
formMetadata.parties-involved: Applicant: The individual applying for the travel document, parole document, or arrival/departure record—either for themselves or on behalf of another person (the beneficiary of parole). Beneficiary (Information About Them): The person outside or inside the U.S. for whom the applicant is requesting parole, if different from the applicant. Interpreter: An individual who translates the application questions and the applicant's answers; completes Part 11. Preparer: A person (attorney, accredited representative, or other) who prepares the form on behalf of the applicant; completes Part 12. Attorney/Accredited Representative: Legal representative indicated by the G-28 checkbox in the header block.

fields.description: Header block checkbox: 'Fill in box if G-28 is attached to represent the applicant.' Indicates that Form G-28, Notice of Entry of Appearance as Attorney or Accredited Representative, is being filed with this I-131.
fields.notes: Check only if an attorney or accredited representative has entered an appearance for this application. If checked, G-28 must be included in the filing package.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 1. Reentry Permit checkbox: 'I am a lawful permanent resident or conditional permanent resident of the United States, and I am applying for a reentry permit.'
fields.notes: Select if the applicant is an LPR or conditional resident. Mutually exclusive with other application type selections (Items 2–11). Triggers Part 5 (time spent outside U.S.) and Part 4 delivery questions. Applicant must be physically present in the U.S. at time of filing. Reentry permit is valid for up to 2 years.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 2. Refugee Travel Document checkbox: 'I now hold refugee or asylee status in the United States, and I am applying for a Refugee Travel Document.'
fields.notes: Select if applicant currently holds refugee or asylee status. Triggers Part 6 (refugee travel document questions). Mutually exclusive with other main application types. Applicant must be physically in U.S. at filing.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 3. Refugee Travel Document checkbox: 'I am a lawful permanent resident as a direct result of refugee or asylee status, and I am applying for a Refugee Travel Document.'
fields.notes: Select if applicant is an LPR who obtained their green card through refugee or asylee adjustment. Triggers Part 6. Travel to the country of persecution may result in loss of status.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 4. TPS Travel Authorization Document checkbox: 'I am a TPS beneficiary in the United States, and I am applying for a TPS Travel Authorization Document under the Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) section 244(f)(3) to allow me to seek admission under TPS upon my return from abroad.'
fields.notes: Select if applicant is a TPS beneficiary inside the U.S. seeking travel authorization. If selected, the receipt number for the last approved I-821 must be entered in the associated text field (P1_Line4).

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5. Advance Parole Document header checkbox: 'I am located inside the United States, and I am applying for an Advance Parole Document to allow me to seek parole into the United States under INA section 212(d)(5)(A) upon my return from abroad based on:' — followed by sub-options A through M.
fields.notes: This is the parent checkbox for Advance Parole. One of the sub-options (5.A through 5.M) must also be selected to specify the basis. Triggers Part 7 (proposed travel information). Applicant must be inside the U.S.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 4. Text field for the receipt number of the applicant's last approved Form I-821, Application for Temporary Protected Status. Appears after the TPS checkbox.
fields.notes: Format: 13-character USCIS receipt number (e.g., EAC-XX-XXX-XXXXX or IOE-XXXXXXXXXX). Only fill if Item 4 (TPS) checkbox is selected. Source: I-797 approval notice for I-821.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.A. Text field for the receipt number of the pending Form I-485, Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status, if filing I-131 separately from I-485.
fields.notes: Only fill if Item 5.A checkbox is selected and the I-131 is filed separately (not concurrently) with I-485. Format: USCIS receipt number from I-797C notice. If filing concurrently with I-485, this may be left blank.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.A. Advance Parole sub-checkbox: 'A pending Form I-485, Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status, receipt number if you are filing this form separately from your Form I-485:'
fields.notes: Select if the advance parole basis is a pending I-485. Most common advance parole basis. If I-485 and I-131 are filed together, the I-485 receipt number field may be left blank until the receipt is issued.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.B. Advance Parole sub-checkbox: 'A pending Form I-589, Application for Asylum and for Withholding of Removal, receipt number:'
fields.notes: Select if basis is a pending asylum application. Enter receipt number in associated text field.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.C. Advance Parole sub-checkbox: 'An approved Form I-918, Petition for U Nonimmigrant Status, or Form I-918, Supplement A, Petition for Qualifying Family Member of U-1 Recipient, receipt number:'
fields.notes: Select if basis is an approved U visa petition. Enter receipt number in associated text field.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.D. Advance Parole sub-checkbox: 'Approved Form I-821D, Consideration of Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals, receipt number:'
fields.notes: Select if basis is approved DACA. DACA advance parole is granted only for humanitarian, educational, or employment purposes. Enter I-821D receipt number.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.E. Advance Parole sub-checkbox: 'An approved Form I-914, Application for T Nonimmigrant Status, or Form I-914, Supplement A, Application for Family Member of T-1 Recipient, receipt number:'
fields.notes: Select if basis is approved T visa. Enter receipt number.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.F. Advance Parole sub-checkbox: 'An approved V Nonimmigrant Status, receipt number:'
fields.notes: Select if basis is V nonimmigrant status (spouse or child of LPR with long-pending I-130). Enter receipt number.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.G. Advance Parole sub-checkbox: 'A pending Form I-687, Application for Status as a Temporary Resident Under Section 245A of the Immigration and Nationality Act, receipt number:'
fields.notes: Rare. Select if basis is a pending I-687 (legalization). Enter receipt number.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.H. Advance Parole sub-checkbox: 'A pending initial Form I-821, Application for Temporary Protected Status, receipt number:'
fields.notes: Select if basis is a pending initial TPS application (not yet approved). Distinct from Item 4 which is for approved TPS. Enter receipt number.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.I. Advance Parole sub-checkbox: 'An approved Form I-817, Application for Family Unity Benefits, receipt number:'
fields.notes: Select if basis is Family Unity benefits. Enter receipt number.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.J. Advance Parole sub-checkbox: 'Deferred Enforced Departure.'
fields.notes: Select if basis is DED. No receipt number required.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.K. Advance Parole sub-checkbox: 'Being a current parolee under INA section 212(d)(5), under class of admission:'
fields.notes: Select if applicant is a current parolee seeking advance parole. Must fill in the class of admission in the associated text field.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.C. Text field for the receipt number of the approved Form I-918 or I-918 Supplement A.
fields.notes: USCIS receipt number format. Only fill if 5.C checkbox is selected.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.E. Text field for the receipt number of the approved Form I-914 or I-914 Supplement A.
fields.notes: USCIS receipt number format. Only fill if 5.E checkbox is selected.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.F. Text field for the receipt number of the approved V Nonimmigrant Status.
fields.notes: Only fill if 5.F checkbox is selected.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.G. Text field for the receipt number of the pending Form I-687.
fields.notes: Only fill if 5.G checkbox is selected.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.H. Text field for the receipt number of the pending initial Form I-821.
fields.notes: Only fill if 5.H checkbox is selected.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.I. Text field for the receipt number of the approved Form I-817.
fields.notes: Only fill if 5.I checkbox is selected.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.L. Advance Parole sub-checkbox: 'CNMI long-term residence, receipt number:'
fields.notes: Select if basis is CNMI long-term resident status. Enter receipt number in associated text field.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.M. Text field for the 'Other (provide explanation)' advance parole basis.
fields.notes: Free-text explanation. Only fill if 5.M checkbox is selected. Describe the specific basis for advance parole not covered by items 5.A–5.L.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.D. Text field for the receipt number of the approved Form I-821D (DACA).
fields.notes: Only fill if 5.D checkbox is selected. Format: USCIS receipt number.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.K. Text field for the class of admission for current parolees.
fields.notes: Enter the COA code shown on the I-94 (e.g., 'PAR', 'DT', 'HP', etc.). Only fill if 5.K checkbox is selected.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.L. Text field for the CNMI long-term residence receipt number.
fields.notes: Only fill if 5.L checkbox is selected.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 6.A. Text field for the Form I-130 receipt number under the Filipino World War II Veterans Parole (FWVP) Program.
fields.notes: Only fill if Item 6.A checkbox is selected. USCIS receipt number format.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.M. Advance Parole sub-checkbox: 'Other (provide explanation):'
fields.notes: Select if the advance parole basis is not covered by items 5.A through 5.L. Provide explanation in the associated text field (P1_Line5M).

fields.description: Part 1, Item 5.B. Text field for the receipt number of the pending Form I-589 (Asylum).
fields.notes: Only fill if 5.B checkbox is selected. Format: USCIS receipt number.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 6. Initial Parole Document header — checkbox for Item 6.A: 'Filipino World War II Veterans Parole (FWVP) Program, Form I-130 receipt number:'
fields.notes: Select if applying for initial parole under the FWVP program. Applicant or beneficiary must be outside the U.S. Enter I-130 receipt number in associated field.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 6.D. Text field for the Family Reunification Task Force (FRTF) Process Task Force Registration Number.
fields.notes: Only fill if Item 6.D checkbox is selected. Enter the FRTF registration number assigned.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 6.D. Initial Parole Document sub-checkbox: 'Family Reunification Task Force (FRTF) Process; Task Force Registration Number:'
fields.notes: Select if applying under the FRTF process. Enter registration number in associated field.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 6.E. Text field for 'Other: (List specific parole program or process)' under Initial Parole Document.
fields.notes: Free-text field. Only fill if Item 6.E checkbox is selected.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 8.A. Text field for the Family Reunification Task Force (FRTF) Process Task Force Registration Number under Parole in Place.
fields.notes: Only fill if Item 8.A checkbox is selected.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 6.E. Initial Parole Document sub-checkbox: 'Other: (List specific parole program or process)'
fields.notes: Select if initial parole under a specific program not listed in 6.A–6.D. Provide program name in associated text field.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 8.B. Text field for 'Other: (List specific program or process)' under Parole in Place IMMVI section.
fields.notes: Free-text. Only fill for IMMVI-related 'Other' specification.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 7. Checkbox: 'I am applying for a parole document under INA section 212(d)(5)(A) for myself and I am outside the United States, or I am applying for a parole document under INA section 212(d)(5)(A) on behalf of someone else who is outside the United States for the first time (initial application), but not under a specific parole program or process.'
fields.notes: Select if requesting initial parole from outside the U.S. but not under any specific named program (Items 6.A–6.E). General discretionary parole request.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 8. Parole in Place header — 'I am applying for an initial period of parole in place under INA section 212(d)(5)(A) and I am inside the United States...' with sub-options A, B, C.
fields.notes: Parent checkbox for Parole in Place applications. Applicant must be inside the U.S. One of sub-options 8.A, 8.B, or 8.C must also be selected.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 8.A. Parole in Place sub-checkbox: 'Family Reunification Task Force (FRTF) Process; Task Force Registration Number:'
fields.notes: Select for FRTF-based PIP. Enter registration number in associated field.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 8.C. Text fields for Intergovernmental Parole Referral: (1) U.S. Federal Executive Branch Government Agency name, and (2) U.S. Federal Government Agency Representative Official Email Address.
fields.notes: Only fill if Item 8.C checkbox is selected. Two sub-fields: agency name and representative email.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 8.B. Text field for 'Other: (List specific program or process)' under IMMVI Parole in Place.
fields.notes: Free-text field for specifying the IMMVI-related program. Only fill if one of the IMMVI sub-options is selected.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 8.B. Parole in Place sub-checkbox: 'Immigrant Military Members and Veterans Initiative (IMMVI)' — with sub-options (1) A current or former service member, (2) A current spouse, child, or unmarried son or daughter..., (3) Current legal guardian or surrogate.
fields.notes: Select for IMMVI-based PIP. Must also select one of the relationship sub-options.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 8.C.(2). Text field for the U.S. Federal Government Agency Representative Official Email Address under Intergovernmental Parole Referral.
fields.notes: Email format. Only fill if Item 8.C is selected.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 8.C. Parole in Place sub-checkbox: 'Intergovernmental Parole Referral'
fields.notes: Select for intergovernmental referral PIP. Must provide agency name and representative email in associated fields.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 8.C.(1). Text field for the U.S. Federal Executive Branch Government Agency name under Intergovernmental Parole Referral.
fields.notes: Full agency name. Only fill if Item 8.C is selected.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 9. Checkbox: 'I am applying for an initial period of parole in place under INA section 212(d)(5)(A) and I am inside the United States, but not under a specific program or process...'
fields.notes: Select if requesting PIP but not under any specific named program (FRTF, IMMVI, Intergovernmental). General discretionary PIP request.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 8.B.(3). Relationship sub-option under IMMVI PIP: 'Current legal guardian or surrogate of a current or former service member.'
fields.notes: Select if applicant is the legal guardian or surrogate of a service member. Only applicable if IMMVI (8.B) is selected.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 8.B.(2). Relationship sub-option under IMMVI PIP: 'A current spouse, child, or unmarried son or daughter (or their child under 21 years of age) of a current or former service member.'
fields.notes: Select if applicant is a family member of a service member. Only applicable if IMMVI (8.B) is selected.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 8.B.(1). Relationship sub-option under IMMVI PIP: 'A current or former service member.'
fields.notes: Select if applicant is themselves a current or former service member. Only applicable if IMMVI (8.B) is selected.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 10. Re-parole header checkbox: 'I was initially paroled into the United States or granted parole in place under INA section 212(d)(5)(A) under one of the following programs or processes and I am requesting a new period of parole...' with sub-options A through I.
fields.notes: Parent checkbox for re-parole under specific programs. One of sub-options 10.A through 10.I must be selected.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 12. Text field: 'If you selected one of the boxes in Item Numbers 10. or 11., list the Admit Until Date/Parole shown on Form I-94: (mm/dd/yyyy)'
fields.notes: Format: mm/dd/yyyy. Enter the 'Admit Until Date' or parole expiration date from the applicant's most recent I-94. Required if Item 10 or 11 is selected.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 10.A. Re-parole sub-checkbox: 'Family Reunification Parole Process'
fields.notes: Select if initial parole was under the Family Reunification Parole Process.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 10.B. Re-parole sub-checkbox: 'Re-parole Process for certain Ukrainian Citizens and Their Immediate Family Members Paroled Into the United States on or After February 11, 2022 (See form Instructions)'
fields.notes: Select if applicant is a Ukrainian citizen (or immediate family member) initially paroled on or after Feb 11, 2022.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 10.E.(1). Relationship sub-option under Military PIP Re-parole: 'A current or former service member.'
fields.notes: Select if applicant themselves is a service member seeking Military PIP re-parole.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 10.E.(3). Relationship sub-option under Military PIP Re-parole: not explicitly visible but likely 'Current legal guardian or surrogate of a current or former service member.'
fields.notes: Based on the pattern from PIP sections. Only applicable under Military PIP re-parole.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 10.E.(2). Relationship sub-option under Military PIP Re-parole: 'A spouse, parent, son, or daughter of a current or former service member.'
fields.notes: Select if applicant is a family member of a service member seeking Military PIP re-parole.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 10.H.(2). Relationship sub-option under IMMVI Re-parole: 'A current spouse, child, or unmarried son or daughter (or their child under 21 years of age) of a current or former service member.'
fields.notes: Select for IMMVI re-parole as a family member of a service member.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 10.H.(1). Relationship sub-option under IMMVI Re-parole: 'A current or former service member.'
fields.notes: Select for IMMVI re-parole as a service member.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 10.C. Re-parole sub-checkbox: 'Certain Afghans Paroled Into the United States After July 31, 2021 (See form Instructions)'
fields.notes: Select if applicant is an Afghan parolee who entered after July 31, 2021 seeking re-parole.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 10.I. Text field for 'Other Program or Process (List specific program or process):' under re-parole.
fields.notes: Free-text. Only fill if Item 10.I checkbox is selected. Specify the re-parole program or process.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 10.D. Re-parole sub-checkbox: 'Filipino World War II Veterans Parole (FWVP) Program'
fields.notes: Select if initial parole was under FWVP and seeking re-parole.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 10.E. Re-parole sub-checkbox: 'Military Parole in Place (Military PIP)' — with relationship sub-options (1) and (2).
fields.notes: Select for Military PIP re-parole. Must also select a relationship sub-option.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 10.F. Re-parole sub-checkbox: 'Central American Minors (CAM) Program'
fields.notes: Select if initial parole was under the CAM program.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 10.G. Re-parole sub-checkbox: 'Family Reunification Task Force (FRTF) Process'
fields.notes: Select if initial parole was under FRTF and seeking re-parole.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 10.H. Re-parole sub-checkbox: 'Immigrant Military Members and Veterans Initiative (IMMVI)' — with relationship sub-options.
fields.notes: Select for IMMVI re-parole. Must also select a relationship sub-option.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 10.I. Re-parole sub-checkbox: 'Other Program or Process (List specific program or process):'
fields.notes: Select if re-parole under a program not listed in 10.A–10.H. Provide details in associated text field.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 1. Middle Name (if applicable) of the applicant.
fields.notes: As shown on passport or travel document. Leave blank if no middle name. Do not enter 'N/A'.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 1. Given Name (First Name) of the applicant.
fields.notes: Must match passport/travel document exactly. No nicknames.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 1. Family Name (Last Name) of the applicant.
fields.notes: Must match passport/travel document exactly. Current legal name.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 13. 'Yes' radio button: 'Do you hold status as a refugee, were you paroled as a refugee, or are you a lawful permanent resident as a direct result of being a refugee?'
fields.notes: Select 'Yes' if the applicant holds or held refugee status or is an LPR as a direct result of refugee status. Mutually exclusive with 'No'.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 13. 'No' radio button: 'Do you hold status as a refugee, were you paroled as a refugee, or are you a lawful permanent resident as a direct result of being a refugee?'
fields.notes: Select 'No' if not applicable. Mutually exclusive with 'Yes'.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 11. Checkbox: 'I was initially paroled into the United States or granted parole in place under INA section 212(d)(5)(A) and I am requesting a new period of parole, but not under a specific program or process...'
fields.notes: Select for general re-parole not under any specific named program. If selected, Item 12 (Admit Until Date) must also be completed.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 3. City or Town of the applicant's current mailing address or safe address.
fields.notes: Full city name. Safe address may be used for victims of domestic violence or other vulnerable applicants.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 3. ZIP Code of the applicant's current mailing address (U.S. addresses).

fields.description: Part 2, Item 3. State of the applicant's current mailing address (U.S. addresses).
fields.notes: Dropdown. Only for U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 3. In Care Of Name (if any) for the applicant's current mailing address.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 3. Street Number and Name of the applicant's current mailing address or safe address.
fields.notes: Mailing address — can be P.O. Box or physical address. This is where USCIS will send notices and documents (unless requesting overseas delivery).

fields.description: Part 2, Item 3. Unit type radio button: 'Apt.' for the applicant's mailing address.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 3. Unit type radio button: 'Ste.' for the applicant's mailing address.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 3. Unit type radio button: 'Flr.' for the applicant's mailing address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Ste.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 3. Apartment, suite, or floor number for the applicant's mailing address.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 3. Postal Code of the applicant's mailing address (foreign addresses).

fields.description: Part 2, Item 3. Province of the applicant's mailing address (foreign addresses).

fields.description: Part 2, Item 4. Country for the applicant's physical address.
fields.notes: Full country name.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 11. USCIS Online Account Number (if any). The applicant's own USCIS online account number.
fields.notes: 12-digit number from myaccount.uscis.gov. Leave blank if none. Not the same as A-Number.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 5. Alien Registration Number (A-Number) (if any). The applicant's USCIS-assigned A-Number.
fields.notes: Up to 9 digits, prefixed with 'A-' on the form. Found on EADs, green cards, I-797 notices. Leave blank if never assigned.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 10. U.S. Social Security Number (if any).
fields.notes: 9-digit SSN. Leave blank if never issued. Format: XXX-XX-XXXX or 9 digits without dashes depending on field.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 8. Sex: 'Male' radio button.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Female.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 8. Sex: 'Female' radio button.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Male.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 9. Date of Birth (mm/dd/yyyy) of the applicant.
fields.notes: Format: mm/dd/yyyy. Must match passport and other identity documents.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 6. Country of Birth of the applicant.
fields.notes: Full country name per DOS conventions. Use current name if country has changed (e.g., 'Russia' not 'USSR').

fields.description: Part 2, Item 7. Country of Citizenship or Nationality of the applicant.
fields.notes: Current citizenship. If stateless, enter 'Stateless'. If dual citizenship, enter primary citizenship.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 12. Class of Admission (COA) (if any). The applicant's immigration class of admission to the U.S.
fields.notes: As shown on the I-94 or green card (e.g., 'LPR', 'RE-1', 'AS-1', 'PAR', 'F-1'). Leave blank if not applicable. Only complete if applicant is inside the U.S. seeking TPS travel, advance parole, re-parole, or PIP.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 13. Most Recent Form I-94 Arrival/Departure Record Number (if any).
fields.notes: 11-digit I-94 number. Retrieved from CBP I-94 website or paper I-94 card. Only complete if applicant is inside the U.S. and selected TPS, advance parole, PIP, or re-parole (Part 1, Items 4, 5, 8, 9, 10, or 11).

fields.description: Part 2, Item 2. Other Names Used — second alias: Middle Name.
fields.notes: Middle name for the second other name/alias. Leave blank if not applicable.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 2. Other Names Used — first alias: Middle Name.
fields.notes: Middle name for the first other name/alias.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 2. Other Names Used — first alias: Given Name (First Name).
fields.notes: First name of the first other name/alias (maiden name, prior married name, nickname used on official documents, etc.).

fields.description: Part 2, Item 2. Other Names Used — first alias: Family Name (Last Name).
fields.notes: Last name of the first other name/alias.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 2. Other Names Used — second alias: Given Name (First Name).
fields.notes: First name of the second alias.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 2. Other Names Used — second alias: Family Name (Last Name).
fields.notes: Last name of the second alias.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 2. Other Names Used — third alias: Middle Name.
fields.notes: Middle name for the third alias.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 2. Other Names Used — third alias: Given Name (First Name).
fields.notes: First name of the third alias.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 2. Other Names Used — third alias: Family Name (Last Name).
fields.notes: Last name of the third alias. If more than 3 aliases are needed, use Part 13.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 16. Family Name (Last Name) of the person on whose behalf the applicant is requesting parole (Information About Them section).
fields.notes: Only complete if applying on behalf of someone else (Items 16–27). As shown on the beneficiary's passport. Do not complete if filing for yourself.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 16. Given Name (First Name) of the parole beneficiary.
fields.notes: Only complete if applying on behalf of another person.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 16. Middle Name (if applicable) of the parole beneficiary.
fields.notes: Leave blank if no middle name.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 17. Their Other Names Used — first alias: Family Name (Last Name) of the parole beneficiary.
fields.notes: Only complete if the beneficiary has used other names.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 17. Their Other Names Used — first alias: Given Name (First Name).
fields.notes: First name of beneficiary's first alias.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 17. Their Other Names Used — first alias: Middle Name.
fields.notes: Middle name of beneficiary's first alias.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 17. Their Other Names Used — second alias: Family Name (Last Name).
fields.notes: Second alias last name of the beneficiary.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 17. Their Other Names Used — second alias: Given Name (First Name).
fields.notes: Second alias first name of the beneficiary.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 17. Their Other Names Used — second alias: Middle Name.
fields.notes: Second alias middle name.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 17. Their Other Names Used — third alias: Family Name (Last Name).
fields.notes: Third alias last name.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 17. Their Other Names Used — third alias: Given Name (First Name).
fields.notes: Third alias first name.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 17. Their Other Names Used — third alias: Middle Name.
fields.notes: Third alias middle name.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 18. Date of Birth (mm/dd/yyyy) of the parole beneficiary.
fields.notes: Format: mm/dd/yyyy. Source: beneficiary's passport or birth certificate.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 19. Country of Birth of the parole beneficiary.
fields.notes: Full country name per DOS conventions.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 20. Country of Citizenship or Nationality of the parole beneficiary.
fields.notes: Current citizenship of the person for whom parole is sought.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 21. Daytime Phone Number of the parole beneficiary.
fields.notes: Include country code if outside the U.S.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 22. Email Address (if any) of the parole beneficiary.
fields.notes: Optional.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 23. Alien Registration Number (A-Number) (if any) of the parole beneficiary.
fields.notes: Up to 9 digits. Leave blank if none assigned.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 24. City or Town of the parole beneficiary's current mailing address.
fields.notes: Beneficiary's mailing address. May be foreign if beneficiary is outside the U.S.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 24. ZIP Code of the beneficiary's mailing address.
fields.notes: Only for U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 24. State of the beneficiary's mailing address.
fields.notes: Only for U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 24. In Care Of Name (if any) for the beneficiary's mailing address.
fields.notes: Leave blank if not applicable.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 24. Street Number and Name of the beneficiary's mailing address.
fields.notes: Mailing address of the parole beneficiary.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 24. Unit type radio button: 'Apt.' for the beneficiary's mailing address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Ste. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 24. Unit type radio button: 'Ste.' for the beneficiary's mailing address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 24. Unit type radio button: 'Flr.' for the beneficiary's mailing address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Ste.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 24. Apartment, suite, or floor number for the beneficiary's mailing address.
fields.notes: Only fill if a unit type is selected.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 24. Postal Code of the beneficiary's mailing address (foreign).
fields.notes: Only for non-U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 24. Province of the beneficiary's mailing address (foreign).
fields.notes: Only for non-U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 24. Country of the beneficiary's mailing address.
fields.notes: Full country name.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 25. City or Town of the beneficiary's current physical address.
fields.notes: Only complete if different from Item 24.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 25. ZIP Code of the beneficiary's physical address.
fields.notes: Only for U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 25. State of the beneficiary's physical address.
fields.notes: Only for U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 25. In Care Of Name (if any) for the beneficiary's physical address.
fields.notes: Leave blank if not applicable.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 25. Street Number and Name of the beneficiary's physical address.
fields.notes: Physical address of the beneficiary.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 25. Unit type radio button: 'Apt.' for the beneficiary's physical address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Ste. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 25. Unit type radio button: 'Ste.' for the beneficiary's physical address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 25. Unit type radio button: 'Flr.' for the beneficiary's physical address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Ste.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 25. Apartment, suite, or floor number for the beneficiary's physical address.
fields.notes: Only fill if a unit type is selected.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 25. Postal Code of the beneficiary's physical address (foreign).
fields.notes: Only for non-U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 25. Province of the beneficiary's physical address (foreign).
fields.notes: Only for non-U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 25. Country of the beneficiary's physical address.
fields.notes: Full country name.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 15. eMedical U.S. Parolee ID (USPID) (if any).
fields.notes: USPID assigned during the eMedical process for parolees. Leave blank if not applicable or not assigned.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 14. Expiration Date of Authorized Stay Shown on Form I-94 (if any) (mm/dd/yyyy).
fields.notes: Format: mm/dd/yyyy. The 'Admit Until Date' shown on the I-94. May say 'D/S' (Duration of Status) for some visa categories — in that case, this field may need clarification.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 26. Class of Admission (COA) (if any) of the parole beneficiary (Information About Them section).
fields.notes: COA from the beneficiary's I-94 or immigration records. Only complete for parole on behalf of another person.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 27. Most Recent Form I-94 Arrival/Departure Record Number (if any) of the parole beneficiary.
fields.notes: 11-digit I-94 number. Only complete for parole on behalf of another person.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 2. Race checkbox: 'Black or African American'. Select all applicable boxes.
fields.notes: Not mutually exclusive — multiple race boxes may be selected. Biographic information of the person who will receive the document.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 2. Race checkbox: 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander'.
fields.notes: Select all that apply.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 2. Race checkbox: 'American Indian or Alaska Native'.
fields.notes: Select all that apply.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 3. Height — Feet component.
fields.notes: Numeric. Enter the number of feet (e.g., '5').

fields.description: Part 3, Item 3. Height — Inches component.
fields.notes: Numeric 0–11. Enter inches beyond the feet value.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 4. Weight — Pounds (first digit or full weight field).
fields.notes: Weight in pounds. This may be a multi-part field or single field depending on PDF structure. Enter full weight in pounds.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 4. Weight — Pounds (second digit component if split).
fields.notes: Part of multi-digit weight entry. Combined with Pound1 and Pound3 to form the total weight.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 4. Weight — Pounds (third digit component if split).
fields.notes: Part of multi-digit weight entry.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 5. Eye Color radio button: 'Black'.
fields.notes: Select only one eye color. Mutually exclusive.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 5. Eye Color radio button: 'Blue'.
fields.notes: Select only one.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 5. Eye Color radio button: 'Brown'.
fields.notes: Select only one.

fields.notes: Select only one.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 5. Eye Color radio button: 'Green'.
fields.notes: Select only one.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 5. Eye Color radio button: 'Hazel'.
fields.notes: Select only one.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 5. Eye Color radio button: 'Maroon'.
fields.notes: Select only one.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 5. Eye Color radio button: 'Pink'.
fields.notes: Select only one.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 6. Hair Color radio button: 'Bald (No Hair)'.
fields.notes: Select only one hair color. Mutually exclusive.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 6. Hair Color radio button: 'Black'.
fields.notes: Select only one.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 6. Hair Color radio button: 'Blond'.
fields.notes: Select only one.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 6. Hair Color radio button: 'Brown'.
fields.notes: Select only one.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 6. Hair Color radio button: 'Gray'.
fields.notes: Select only one.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 6. Hair Color radio button: 'Red'.
fields.notes: Select only one.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 6. Hair Color radio button: 'Sandy'.
fields.notes: Select only one.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 6. Hair Color radio button: 'White'.
fields.notes: Select only one.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 6. Hair Color radio button: 'Unknown/Other'.
fields.notes: Select only one.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 2. Race checkbox: 'Asian'.
fields.notes: Select all that apply.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 2. Race checkbox: 'White'.
fields.notes: Select all that apply.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 1. Ethnicity radio button: 'Hispanic or Latino'.
fields.notes: Select only one ethnicity. Mutually exclusive with 'Not Hispanic or Latino'.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 1. Ethnicity radio button: 'Not Hispanic or Latino'.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with 'Hispanic or Latino'.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 5. Eye Color radio button: 'Unknown/Other'.
fields.notes: Select only one.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 2.c. Disposition of the last issued Reentry Permit or Refugee Travel Document (e.g., 'attached, lost, stolen, damaged/destroyed, still in my possession, etc.').
fields.notes: Free-text. Only fill if Item 2.a. is answered 'Yes'. Common entries: 'Still in my possession', 'Lost', 'Stolen', 'Damaged', 'Attached'.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 2.a. 'Yes' radio button: 'Have you EVER before been issued a Reentry Permit or Refugee Travel Document?'
fields.notes: If 'Yes', must complete Items 2.b. (date issued) and 2.c. (disposition).

fields.description: Part 4, Item 2.a. 'No' radio button: 'Have you EVER before been issued a Reentry Permit or Refugee Travel Document?'
fields.notes: If 'No', skip Items 2.b. and 2.c.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 2.b. Date Issued (mm/dd/yyyy) of the last Reentry Permit or Refugee Travel Document.
fields.notes: Format: mm/dd/yyyy. Only fill if Item 2.a. is 'Yes'.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 1. 'Yes' radio button: 'Has the person who will receive the travel document, parole document, or Arrival/Departure Record, if approved, been in any exclusion, deportation, removal, or rescission proceedings?'
fields.notes: Critical question. 'Yes' answer may require additional documentation or explanation. Does not automatically bar issuance but triggers additional review.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 1. 'No' radio button: 'Has the person who will receive the travel document, parole document, or Arrival/Departure Record, if approved, been in any exclusion, deportation, removal, or rescission proceedings?'
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with 'Yes'.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 3.a. 'Yes' radio button: 'Have you EVER been issued an Advance Parole Document?'
fields.notes: If 'Yes', must complete Items 3.b. and 3.c.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 3.a. 'No' radio button: 'Have you EVER been issued an Advance Parole Document?'
fields.notes: If 'No', skip Items 3.b. and 3.c.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 3.b. Date Issued (mm/dd/yyyy) of the last Advance Parole Document.
fields.notes: Format: mm/dd/yyyy. Only fill if Item 3.a. is 'Yes'.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 3.c. Disposition of the last Advance Parole Document.
fields.notes: Free-text. Same options as 2.c.: attached, lost, stolen, damaged/destroyed, still in my possession.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 4. 'Yes' radio button: 'Are you requesting a replacement Reentry Permit, Refugee Travel Document, Advance Parole Document, or TPS Travel Authorization Document?'
fields.notes: If 'Yes', must complete Item 5 (reason) and Items 6.a.–6.b. If requesting parole from outside, PIP, or re-parole, skip to Part 8 instead.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 4. 'No' radio button: 'Are you requesting a replacement Reentry Permit, Refugee Travel Document, Advance Parole Document, or TPS Travel Authorization Document?'
fields.notes: If 'No', skip to Item 7.a.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 5. Replacement reason checkbox: 'I received my document, but then it was lost, stolen, or damaged.'
fields.notes: Select one of the four replacement reasons. Only complete if Item 4 is 'Yes'.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 5. Replacement reason checkbox: 'My document was issued, but I did not receive it.'
fields.notes: Select one of the four replacement reasons.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 5. Replacement reason checkbox: 'I received my document, but it has incorrect information because of an error caused by me or because my information has changed.'
fields.notes: If selected, must complete Item 6.a. correction checkboxes and explanation.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 5. Replacement reason checkbox: 'I received my document, but it has incorrect information because of an error not caused by me (such as a U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) error).'
fields.notes: If USCIS error, no additional fee may be required for the replacement. Must complete Item 6.a. and provide supporting evidence.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 6.a. Correction needed checkbox: 'Name'.
fields.notes: Select if the name on the issued document is incorrect. Multiple correction boxes can be selected.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 6.a. Correction needed checkbox: 'A-Number'.
fields.notes: Select if the A-Number on the document is incorrect.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 6.a. Correction needed checkbox: 'Country of Birth/Citizenship'.
fields.notes: Select if country of birth or citizenship is incorrect on the document.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 6.a. Correction needed checkbox: 'Terms and Conditions'.
fields.notes: Select if terms/conditions on the document are incorrect.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 6.a. Correction needed checkbox: 'Date of Birth'.
fields.notes: Select if DOB on the document is incorrect.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 6.a. Correction needed checkbox: 'Sex'.
fields.notes: Select if sex is incorrect on the document.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 6.a. Correction needed checkbox: 'Validity Date'.
fields.notes: Select if the validity/expiration date on the document is incorrect.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 6.a. Correction needed checkbox: 'Photo'.
fields.notes: Select if the photo on the document is incorrect.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 6.a. Text field: 'Provide an explanation of what is incorrect on your current document to support your request for a correction and attach copies of any documents supporting your request.'
fields.notes: Free-text explanation. Required when replacement is for incorrect information. Describe what is wrong and what the correct information should be.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 6.b. Text field: 'Provide the receipt number for the Form I-131 related to the Reentry Permit, Refugee Travel Document, Advance Parole Document, or TPS Travel Authorization Document that you are seeking to replace:'
fields.notes: USCIS receipt number of the original I-131 application. Required for replacement requests.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 7.a. Delivery location checkbox: 'To the U.S. address shown in Part 2., Item Number 3. of this application.'
fields.notes: Select if you want the Reentry Permit or Refugee Travel Document mailed to your U.S. mailing address. Mutually exclusive with 7.b. Only for reentry permit and refugee travel document applicants.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 7.b. Delivery location checkbox: 'To a U.S. Embassy, U.S. Consulate, USCIS international field office, or Department of Homeland Security (DHS) office overseas at:'
fields.notes: Select if you want the document sent to a foreign post. Must provide city and country. Mutually exclusive with 7.a.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 7.b. City or Town of the U.S. Embassy, Consulate, or USCIS office overseas where the document should be sent.
fields.notes: Only fill if Item 7.b. checkbox is selected.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 7.b. Country of the U.S. Embassy, Consulate, or USCIS office overseas.
fields.notes: Only fill if Item 7.b. checkbox is selected. Full country name.

fields.description: Part 5, Item 1. Time outside U.S. checkbox: 'Less Than 6 Months'.
fields.notes: Part 5 is only for reentry permit applicants (Part 1, Item 1). Select one time range. Affects the validity period of the reentry permit.

fields.description: Part 5, Item 1. Time outside U.S. checkbox: '6 Months to 1 Year'.
fields.notes: Select one time range.

fields.description: Part 5, Item 1. Time outside U.S. checkbox: '1 to 2 Years'.
fields.notes: Select one time range.

fields.description: Part 5, Item 1. Time outside U.S. checkbox: '2 to 3 Years'.
fields.notes: Select one time range.

fields.description: Part 5, Item 1. Time outside U.S. checkbox: '3 to 4 Years'.
fields.notes: Select one time range.

fields.description: Part 5, Item 1. Time outside U.S. checkbox: 'More Than 4 Years'.
fields.notes: Select one time range. Selecting higher ranges may result in a shorter validity reentry permit and may raise questions about abandonment of permanent residence.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 8.a. Notification address checkbox: 'To the address shown in Part 2., Item Number 3. of this application.'
fields.notes: Select if pickup notification should be sent to the applicant's U.S. mailing address. Only applicable if document is being sent overseas (Item 7.b. selected). Mutually exclusive with 8.b.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 8.b. Notification address checkbox: 'To the address shown below in Part 4., Item Number 9.a. of this application.'
fields.notes: Select if pickup notification should be sent to a different address specified in Item 9.a. Mutually exclusive with 8.a.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 9.a. In Care Of Name (if any) for the alternate notification address.
fields.notes: Only fill if Item 8.b. is selected.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 9.a. City or Town of the alternate notification address.
fields.notes: Only fill if Item 8.b. is selected.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 9.a. ZIP Code of the alternate notification address.
fields.notes: Only for U.S. addresses. Only fill if Item 8.b. is selected.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 9.a. State of the alternate notification address.
fields.notes: Only for U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 9.a. Street Number and Name of the alternate notification address.
fields.notes: Only fill if Item 8.b. is selected.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 9.a. Unit type radio button: 'Apt.' for the alternate notification address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Ste. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 9.a. Unit type radio button: 'Ste.' for the alternate notification address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 9.a. Unit type radio button: 'Flr.' for the alternate notification address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Ste.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 9.a. Apartment, suite, or floor number for the alternate notification address.
fields.notes: Only fill if a unit type is selected.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 9.a. Postal Code of the alternate notification address (foreign).
fields.notes: Only for non-U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 9.a. Province of the alternate notification address (foreign).
fields.notes: Only for non-U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 9.a. Country of the alternate notification address.
fields.notes: Full country name.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 9.c. Email Address for the alternate notification address.
fields.notes: Optional contact info for document pickup notification.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 9.b. Daytime Phone Number for the alternate notification address.
fields.notes: Despite field ID referencing 'Email', the printed form labels this as Item 9.b. Daytime Phone Number.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 2. 'Yes' radio button: 'Do you plan to travel to the country named above in Item Number 1.?'
fields.notes: Part 6 is only for refugee travel document applicants. If 'Yes', explain in Part 13. Traveling to the country of persecution may jeopardize refugee/asylee status.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 2. 'No' radio button: 'Do you plan to travel to the country named above in Item Number 1.?'
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with 'Yes'.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 1. Country from which you are a refugee or asylee.
fields.notes: Full country name. This is the country of persecution. Critical for determining whether proposed travel would affect status.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 3.b. 'Yes' radio button: 'Applied for and/or obtained a national passport, passport renewal, or entry permit from the country in Item Number 1.?'
fields.notes: If 'Yes', must explain in Part 13. Obtaining a passport from the country of persecution may be evidence of re-availment and could lead to loss of status.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 3.c. 'Yes' radio button: 'Applied for and/or received any benefit from the country named in Item Number 1. (for example, health insurance benefits)?'
fields.notes: If 'Yes', must explain in Part 13.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 3.c. 'No' radio button for benefits question.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with 'Yes'.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 3.b. 'No' radio button for passport question.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with 'Yes'.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 3.a. 'Yes' radio button: 'Returned to the country named above in Item Number 1.?'
fields.notes: If 'Yes', must explain in Part 13. Returning to the country of persecution may constitute re-availment and jeopardize status.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 3.a. 'No' radio button for return to country question.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with 'Yes'.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 4.a. 'Yes' radio button: 'Reacquired the nationality of the country named above in Item Number 1.?'
fields.notes: If 'Yes', explain in Part 13. Re-acquisition of nationality of persecution country may terminate refugee/asylee status under INA §208(c)(2).

fields.description: Part 6, Item 4.b. 'Yes' radio button: 'Acquired a new nationality?'
fields.notes: If 'Yes', explain in Part 13.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 5. 'Yes' radio button: 'Are you filing for a Refugee Travel Document before departing the United States?'
fields.notes: If 'Yes', may skip Items 6.a.–6.c. Filing before departure is the standard procedure.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 5. 'No' radio button: 'Are you filing for a Refugee Travel Document before departing the United States?'
fields.notes: If 'No', must answer Items 6.a.–6.c. Filing from outside the U.S. is generally only possible under limited circumstances.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 4.b. 'No' radio button for acquired new nationality question.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with 'Yes'.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 4.a. 'No' radio button for reacquired nationality question.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with 'Yes'.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 6.a. 'Yes' radio button: 'Are you currently outside the United States?'
fields.notes: Only answer if Item 5 is 'No'. If 'Yes', must provide current location in 6.b. and travel history in 6.c.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 6.a. 'No' radio button: 'Are you currently outside the United States?'
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with 'Yes'.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 6.b. Text field: 'If you answered "Yes," what is your current location (City or Town and Country)?'
fields.notes: Enter city/town and country. Only fill if Item 6.a. is 'Yes'.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 6.c. Text field: 'If you answered "Yes," what other countries have you traveled to since leaving the United States?'
fields.notes: List all countries visited since departing the U.S. Only fill if Item 6.a. is 'Yes'.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 4. Trip frequency checkbox: 'One Trip'.
fields.notes: Part 7 is only for advance parole applicants (Part 1, Item 5). Mutually exclusive with 'More than one trip'.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 4. Trip frequency checkbox: 'More than one trip'.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with 'One Trip'. Multiple-trip AP allows re-entry multiple times during validity.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 5. Expected Length of Trip (in days).
fields.notes: Numeric. Enter estimated total days of travel. For multiple trips, enter the total expected days abroad.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 2. Purpose of trip.
fields.notes: Free-text. Common purposes: family emergency, business, education, humanitarian. For DACA advance parole, must demonstrate humanitarian, educational, or employment purpose. Use Part 13 for overflow.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 1. Date of Intended Departure (mm/dd/yyyy).
fields.notes: Format: mm/dd/yyyy. Must be a future date. The advance parole document should be approved before this date.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 3. List the countries you intend to visit.
fields.notes: Free-text. List all intended destination countries. Use Part 13 for overflow.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 4.c. 'No' radio button: 'Been granted refugee or asylee status in any other country?'
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with 'Yes'.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 4.c. 'Yes' radio button: 'Been granted refugee or asylee status in any other country?'
fields.notes: If 'Yes', explain in Part 13.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 1. Checkbox: 'I am requesting an Employment Authorization Document (EAD) upon approval of my new period of parole (re-parole) selected under Part 1., Item Number 10. or 11.'
fields.notes: Only for re-parole applicants (Items 10 or 11). If checked, USCIS will issue an EAD upon re-parole approval. This is a concurrent EAD request.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 3.a. Date of Intended Arrival to the United States (mm/dd/yyyy).
fields.notes: Format: mm/dd/yyyy. Only complete if the person intended to receive the parole document is outside the United States. Part 8 is for initial parole, PIP, or re-parole applicants.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 3.b. City or Town of the U.S. Embassy, U.S. Consulate, or USCIS international field office to be notified.
fields.notes: Only for persons outside the U.S. Specify where they want USCIS to send the parole document notification.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 3.b. Country of the U.S. Embassy, Consulate, or USCIS international field office.
fields.notes: Full country name.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 2. Expected Length of Stay in the United States.
fields.notes: Free-text. Describe the expected duration of stay (e.g., '6 months', '1 year'). For parole applicants.

fields.description: Part 10, Item 4. Date of Signature (mm/dd/yyyy). The date the applicant signs the form.
fields.notes: Format: mm/dd/yyyy. Must be the actual date of signing.

fields.description: Part 10, Item 4. Applicant's Signature. The applicant's wet-ink or electronic signature attesting to the certification: 'I certify, under penalty of perjury, that I provided or authorized all of the responses and information contained in and submitted with my application, I read and understand or, if interpreted to me in a language in which I am fluent by the interpreter listed in Part 11., understood, all of the responses and information contained in, and submitted with, my application (as explained to me by the interpreter), and that all of the responses and the information are complete, true, and correct. Furthermore, I authorize the release of any information from any and all of my records that USCIS may need to determine my eligibility for an immigration request and to other entities and persons where necessary for the administration and enforcement of U.S. immigration law.'
fields.notes: Signature field. Must be signed by the applicant. Cannot be signed by the preparer or attorney on the applicant's behalf. A missing signature will result in rejection.

fields.description: Part 10, Item 1. Applicant's Daytime Telephone Number.
fields.notes: Include area code. Include country code if outside the U.S.

fields.description: Part 10, Item 2. Applicant Mobile Telephone Number (if any).
fields.notes: Optional.

fields.description: Part 10, Item 3. Applicant's Email Address (if any).
fields.notes: Optional. USCIS may use for electronic notifications.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 1. Text field: 'Explain how you qualify for parole, parole in place, or re-parole.' Include supporting documentation references.
fields.notes: Free-text narrative. Critical for discretionary parole requests. Explain the urgent humanitarian reasons or significant public benefit. Use Part 13 for overflow. Attach supporting evidence.

fields.description: Part 11, Item 3. Interpreter's Daytime Telephone Number.
fields.notes: Required if Part 11 is completed.

fields.description: Part 11, Item 4. Interpreter's Mobile Telephone Number (if any).
fields.notes: Optional.

fields.description: Part 11, Item 5. Interpreter's Email Address (if any).
fields.notes: Optional.

fields.description: Part 11, Item 6. Interpreter's Signature. The interpreter certifies under penalty of perjury: 'I certify, under penalty of perjury, that I am fluent in English and [language], and I have interpreted every question on the application and Instructions and interpreted the applicant's answers to the questions in that language, and the applicant informed me that he or she understood every instruction, question, and answer on the application.'
fields.notes: Signature field. Must be wet-ink or electronic signature.

fields.description: Part 11, Item 6. Date of Signature (mm/dd/yyyy) of the interpreter.
fields.notes: Format: mm/dd/yyyy.

fields.description: Part 11, Interpreter's Certification. Language field: 'I certify, under penalty of perjury, that I am fluent in English and [language]...'
fields.notes: Enter the full language name (e.g., 'Spanish', 'Mandarin Chinese'). Must be the language used to interpret the form for the applicant.

fields.description: Part 11, Item 1. Interpreter's Family Name (Last Name).
fields.notes: Legal last name of the interpreter.

fields.description: Part 11, Item 1. Interpreter's Given Name (First Name).
fields.notes: Legal first name of the interpreter.

fields.description: Part 11, Item 2. Interpreter's Business or Organization Name (if any).
fields.notes: Leave blank if interpreter has no organizational affiliation.

fields.description: Part 12, Item 6. Preparer's Signature. The preparer certifies under penalty of perjury: 'I certify, under penalty of perjury, that I prepared this application for the applicant at his or her request and with express consent and that all the responses and information contained in and submitted with the application are complete, true, and correct and reflects only information provided by the applicant. The applicant reviewed the responses and information and informed me that he or she understands the responses and information in or submitted with the application.'
fields.notes: Signature field. Must be wet-ink or electronic signature.

fields.description: Part 12, Item 6. Date of Signature (mm/dd/yyyy) of the preparer.
fields.notes: Format: mm/dd/yyyy.

fields.description: Part 12, Item 1. Preparer's Family Name (Last Name).
fields.notes: Legal last name of the preparer.

fields.description: Part 12, Item 1. Preparer's Given Name (First Name).
fields.notes: Legal first name of the preparer.

fields.description: Part 12, Item 2. Preparer's Business or Organization Name.
fields.notes: Law firm or organization name. Leave blank if individual preparer with no affiliation.

fields.description: Part 12, Item 5. Preparer's Email Address (if any).
fields.notes: Optional.

fields.description: Part 12, Item 3. Preparer's Daytime Telephone Number.
fields.notes: Required if Part 12 is completed.

fields.description: Part 12, Item 4. Preparer's Mobile Telephone Number (if any).
fields.notes: Optional.

fields.description: Part 13, Item 1. Family Name (Last Name) of the applicant — repeated at the top of the additional information page for identification.
fields.notes: Must match Part 2, Item 1. Required on every continuation sheet.

fields.description: Part 13, Item 1. Given Name (First Name) of the applicant — repeated on the continuation page.
fields.notes: Must match Part 2, Item 1.

fields.description: Part 13, Item 1. Middle Name of the applicant — repeated on the continuation page.
fields.notes: Must match Part 2, Item 1.

fields.description: Part 13, Item 2. A-Number (if any) — repeated at the top of the additional information page.
fields.notes: Must match Part 2, Item 5. Required per instructions on every continuation sheet.

fields.description: Part 13, Row 3. Page Number — the page of the form being continued.
fields.notes: Enter the page number (1–14) of the original item.

fields.description: Part 13, Row 3. Part Number — the part number being continued.
fields.notes: Enter the part number (1–12).

fields.description: Part 13, Row 3. Item Number — the specific item being continued.
fields.notes: Enter the item number (e.g., '1.', '3.b.', '6.c.').

fields.description: Part 13, Row 3. Additional information text field for the item referenced.
fields.notes: Overflow text. Common uses: additional explanation for Part 6 questions, Part 7 travel purpose, Part 8 parole qualification explanation.

fields.description: Part 13, Row 4. Page Number.
fields.notes: Page number of the item being continued.

fields.description: Part 13, Row 4. Part Number.
fields.notes: Part number of the item being continued.

fields.notes: Item number of the field being continued.

fields.description: Part 13, Row 4. Additional information text field.
fields.notes: Overflow content for the referenced item.

fields.notes: Page number of the item being continued.

fields.notes: Part number of the item being continued.

fields.notes: Item number of the field being continued.

fields.description: Part 13, Row 5. Additional information text field.
fields.notes: Overflow content.

fields.notes: Page number of the item being continued.

fields.notes: Part number of the item being continued.

fields.notes: Item number of the field being continued.

fields.notes: Page number of the item being continued.

fields.notes: Item number of the field being continued.
